sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: One of the Fabula brothers, renowned storybook writers from ancient Seltavia, Diqut was in charge of the writing. Alongside his younger brother, the illustrator, they gained immense popularity in Seltavia. However, at one point, he started struggling with the direction of his works. One day, after a disagreement with his brother, he disappeared from their home. He traveled through the Lumelax region, sharing altered versions of his stories with the people. Everyone who heard these tales reportedly became consumed by a negative force.

|member = |gamedebut = |aliases = |counterpart = Dark Scribe Diqut |bf2 = true }} '''Diqut''' is a character introduced in Brave Frontier II. ==In-Game Appearance== ==Background== ==History== ===Brave Frontier Heroes=== One of the Fabula brothers, renowned storybook writers from ancient Seltavia, Diqut was in charge of the writing. Alongside his younger brother, the illustrator, they gained immense popularity in Seltavia. However, at one point, he started struggling with the direction of his works. One day, after a disagreement with his brother, he disappeared from their home. He traveled through the Lumelax region, sharing altered versions of his stories with the people.
